about: Step 6, temp book staging/paths.js (Mid's 09-nav, the walking grid): every piece. in v100: already home. bring: comes with its feature, as book entries and laws. cut: v100 does it another way (most are speed aids or a second copy of what index.html's tiles and A* already do).

NC: the squares a side: index.html N (D2 board over D12 tile)
POCKET: Mid's joined-region size for a closed-in pocket; v100's findPath gives up at its search budget instead of keeping regions
NAV: the grid's store: index.html OCC (what stands on a tile), H and DEP (water); Mid's per-side gates come with gates as doors, its path budget is cut
COORD: F11: measure D190 (100), the letters J6
coord: F11: menu.js, coord(bx, by) beside the other words helpers (not index.html's frames: a words helper, and the frames hold no room for its numbers): measured from the board's corner B0, A1 to V22
snapPos: a building's tiles from a point: the ghost's i, j in menu.js and spot in ai.js
navRebuild: v100 keeps OCC up to date at each build, unbuild and take: no grid to rebuild
blockedCell: F15: index.html walkable asks the shut hook for a gate (GATES), combat.js answers by isFoe; the Gate tick (SC22)
COMPS: joined regions, a speed aid; v100's findPath gives up at its budget
flood: joined regions, a speed aid; v100's findPath gives up at its budget
compOf: joined regions, a speed aid; v100's findPath gives up at its budget
lineClear: a straight walk when nothing is in the way; v100 walks tile to tile by A* (QBL)
freeNear: the nearest free square in rings; v100 asks findPath with a goal (goBeside, goBy) and ai.js spot
DANGER: the danger map: where workers will not go (foes, towers, fire, a fright), in three levels; villagers' safety
DISC: part of the danger map (a disc's rows, worked out once)
dangerMap: the danger map, redrawn every second for each side
dangerWhy: why a villager left a find, in words (with the danger map)
AS: A*'s working arrays; v100's findPath has its own
DX8: A*'s eight ways; v100's findPath has its own
wayLen: F14: index.html wayLen(): the A* path's length from a tile to beside a building (QBL)
astar: index.html findPath (QBL); Mid also returned the way to the nearest point when the goal can't be reached
findBlocker: a soldier stopped by an enemy wall or building attacks it (War)
standOff: index.html goBy and goBeside: a tile along the edge on the walker's side
route: index.html walkTo and step; Mid's shared path for a big army and per-tick path budget are speed aids v100 doesn't need yet
paceOf: F17b: index.html floor 5, pace(u): the one law QCB, Pandolf's walking cost solved for the speed (load, grade, η, the wind's drag), × the states (D224); stride walks at it
stepTo: index.html step: metres walked turn the stride (QBU)
moveTo: index.html step and walkTo; Mid's slip on ice (QR) and ruts (KI15, held) are not in v100
canPlace: F15: econ.js placeWhy (D206): two squares round buildings and from finds, a lane round trainers, Mid's words; a trade post on a stop and a dock by a lake wait for trade stops and water (neither is priced in v100)
findSpot: ai.js spot: rings out from a centre
sealSeen: F15: econ.js sealPath walks by findPath (QBL), which keeps its own
sealGen: F15: econ.js sealPath walks by findPath (QBL), which keeps its own
sealPath: F15: econ.js sealPath: a foe's walk out from the Town Center's floor by findPath (QBL), the walls being laid counted
